name: MACROGOL 3350 17 GR POWDER 7 SACHETS
description: Macrogol 3350, 17 g powder, packaged in 7 sachets, is used for the treatment of occasional or chronic constipation. It belongs to the class of osmotic laxatives, which work by attracting water into the stool to soften it and increase its bulk, thus facilitating bowel movements. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
